_howToEdit: This file holds the special events shown on the Events page.
Add one { } block per event inside the "events" list below.
time  — shown on the right of the card, e.g. "5:00 PM" or "5:00 & 7:00 PM".
Put a comma after every block EXCEPT the last one.
Weekly Sunday and Wednesday gatherings are automatic — do not add them here.
Past events disappear from the list on their own; you can leave or delete them.
